text:
oliver: heads-up — onboarding rerank failing in CI and a customer report. Error: 
```n{"error":"bad_request","message":"vector length mismatch: expected 1536 got 1524 (item 5)"}
```n
maya: sigh. does the sampleapp send top-level "vectors" or "items"? and any chance vectors are being compacted?

oliver: sampleapp uses a helper that emits `vectors` for compactness. captured payload (sanitized):
```nPOST /v1/rerank
{
  "vectors": [ [0.12,0.34,...,0.0 /* seems trimmed */], [0.98, ...] ],
  "query": "best onboarding steps"
}
```n
harpreet: two problems colliding: 1) schema mismatch (runtime expects `items: [{id, vector}]`) 2) some SDKs (browser + tiny mobile serializer) are dropping trailing zeros to shrink payload. That moves indices when batching and makes retry logic resend wrong ids.

maya: repro steps for engineers: clone sampleapp -> yarn -> start -> run onboarding -> watch POST /v1/rerank fail intermittently. I can reproduce locally ~1/10 runs.

harpreet: quick local mitigation: in sampleapp middleware map `vectors` -> `items` and pad to modelDim (1536). snippet: 
```nfunction normalize(body,dim=1536){
  const items = (body.vectors||[]).map((v,i)=>({id:`i${i}`,vector: padTo(v,dim)}));
  return {items, query: body.query};
}
```n
oliver: added that patch to a quick branch and CI passed. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/999 (WIP).

maya: SDK asks: can we stop compacting arrays by default? We need parity across Node/Python/Android/iOS. Also add `preserveTrailingZeros` flag and `padVectors:true|false` option for gradual rollout.

harpreet: I'll add a pre-send validator in the batcher that checks vector lengths, injects per-item idempotency tokens, and refuses to send if shapes vary. That should stop duplicate retries.

ci-bot: created issue on SDK repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/401 - "preserve trailing zeros + padVectors option + parity tests" assigned to @harpreet. Tests: node, browser, android, ios.

oliver: runtime UX note: when dims mismatch return clearer error text with a hint, e.g., "expected 1536 got 1524; check client trimming/padding or header race" and include header X-Redwood-Debug: header_dim=.. body_dim=.. if present. That will save debugging time.

qa: adding an e2e: run sampleapp onboarding flow under network throttling & mobile emulators to catch racey trims. Will mark flaky and track until SDK patch lands.

maya: thanks. timeline: SDK patch + batcher validator in 2 days, sampleapp patch merged as stopgap. I'll coordinate with QA for Canary run after merge. :thumbsup:
